s.how: Peel and devein 600g cooked king prawns, leaving a few tails on for the tops. Mix 120g mayonnaise, 2 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tsp Worcestershire, a few drops of hot sauce and the juice of half a lemon until pink and smooth. Shred 1 cos heart and divide between 8 small glasses. Add diced avocado (1 total) and the prawns, spoon over the sauce, dust with paprika and add a lemon wedge.

s.n: Beach Ken watermelon and feta skewers
s.note: the beach where Ken's job is just beach
s.how: Cut a quarter of a watermelon into 3cm cubes and chill well. Cut 200g firm feta and 1 continental cucumber into similar cubes. Thread onto 12 skewers in the order watermelon, mint leaf, feta, cucumber, watermelon. Lay on a platter, squeeze over the juice of 1 lime and drizzle with 2 tbsp olive oil. Mix 1 tsp salt with half a tsp chilli flakes and sprinkle over just before serving.

m.how: Roast 3 beetroot wrapped in foil at 200C for 50 minutes, peel and blend with 250g ricotta, 1 garlic clove, 40g parmesan and a splash of pasta water. Toss through 500g cooked penne until glossy and pink, and crumble 100g goat's cheese over the top.

w.how: Make 8 waffles from 300g waffle mix. Blitz 150g strawberries with 2 tbsp sugar for a pink sauce. Whip 300ml cream. Stack the waffles with cream, 250g sliced strawberries and the pink sauce poured over.

d.note: pink, cold and actually in the cup this time
d.how: Melt 50g white chocolate and dip the rims of 4 tall glasses in it, then into 3 tbsp sprinkles. Chill the glasses 10 minutes. Blend 300g hulled strawberries with 500g vanilla ice cream, 300ml cold milk and 1 tbsp honey until thick and pink. Pour into the glasses, top with whipped cream (100ml whipped) and a halved strawberry.
